Your billing information is tokenized us: Your billing information is tokenized using PCI-compliant payment gateways (Stripe, Fawry). We never store raw credit card details or wallet PINs in our databases.

We allow returns on eligible products wi: We allow returns on eligible products within 14 days of receipt. Items must be returned in their original packaging, showing zero signs of wear or customization changes.
Standard courier orders within the Cairo: Standard courier orders within the Cairo & Giza metropolitan areas are delivered within 3-5 business days. Express shipping delivers custom studio pieces in 1-2 days
To maintain luxury standards, standard s: To maintain luxury standards, standard shipping is complimentary for order subtotals exceeding 10,000 EGP. Orders below this threshold incur a flat rate of 250 EGP.
Digital products (source files, blueprin: Digital products (source files, blueprints, certificates) are not subject to shipping fees and are instantly whitelisted for download in the customer account dashboard upon payment confirmation.
By accessing and purchasing from Shop Pr: By accessing and purchasing from Shop Premium, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Use, as well as all applicable local laws and safety standards.
All orders are subject to stock availabi: All orders are subject to stock availability and validation checks. For custom pieces, shipping timelines are estimated and may vary depending on designer queue sizes.
Users are responsible for maintaining th: Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their profile credentials. Any unauthorized use or security alerts must be immediately reported to our concierge desk.
